agenteCapital.name: Agente Capital
agenteCapital.headline: Zoho data turned into commissions, receivables, and internal answers.
agenteCapital.summary: An internal platform that retrieves Zoho CRM data to visualize commercial operations, calculate team commissions, and track the amounts to be collected from each developer.
agenteCapital.context: Commercial data from Zoho needed to support two separate workflows—internal commissions and developer receivables—plus a faster way to query internal knowledge.
agenteCapital.build: I developed the Zoho data integration and visualization, the commission and developer receivables modules, and a RAG agent for querying the knowledge base.
agenteCapital.evidence: 50+ SQL migrations, 141 included test cases, and continuous evolution documented in the repository.
agenteCapital.role: Architecture · Internal product · Data · Zoho integration
agenteCapital.evolution: The direct WhatsApp integration was only a prototype. Conversational operations moved to the Chatwoot fork and are not part of Agente Capital's current flow.
agenteCapital.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Pinecone · Zoho CRM API

chatwoot.name: Chatwoot Capital Plus
chatwoot.headline: Conversations and calls turned into operational context.
chatwoot.summary: A custom distribution of Chatwoot 4.x connecting customer support, telephony, CRM, and commercial analysis through a traceable workflow.
chatwoot.context: Aircall, WhatsApp, and Zoho CRM needed to exchange context while long-running processes executed without blocking operations.
chatwoot.build: I implemented webhooks, asynchronous jobs, retries, and idempotency, plus transcription pipelines, Call Intelligence, and Revenue Intelligence.
chatwoot.evidence: 315 evolution commits, verified RSpec runs with no failures, and CI covering security analysis, linting, and tests.
chatwoot.credit: Built on the open-source Chatwoot project. This case separates the original foundation from the integrations and modules I added.
chatwoot.stack: Ruby on Rails · Sidekiq · Redis · PostgreSQL · Aircall · Zoho CRM · Docker

puntoTierra.name: Punto Tierra
puntoTierra.headline: A real-estate experience connected to the commercial process.
puntoTierra.summary: A web application for exploring developments and properties, capturing prospects, and measuring the journey from visit to CRM.
puntoTierra.context: The catalog needed to support exploration while sending each opportunity into the commercial workflow with consistent measurement.
puntoTierra.build: I developed the catalog, dynamic property pages, galleries, Zoho-connected forms, Meta Pixel, and the Conversions API with event deduplication.
puntoTierra.evidence: Product routes, structured data, technical SEO, server-side CRM integration, and client-server measurement.
puntoTierra.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · Zoho CRM · Meta CAPI · JSON-LD · Technical SEO

carmen.name: Carmen Cárdena Boutique
carmen.headline: Boutique operations, from catalog to checkout.
carmen.summary: A system connecting the public experience with internal sales, inventory, and administrative workflows.
carmen.context: Catalog, sales, stock, rentals, repairs, and cash management needed to share the same operational state.
carmen.build: I developed POS, multi-location inventory, cash management, rentals, repairs, reporting, and content-management modules.
carmen.evidence: Domain services, transactional operations, record locking, and architecture, operations, and deployment documentation.
carmen.stack: Django · PostgreSQL · HTMX · Alpine.js · Bootstrap · Render
